readout.caveat: exploratory: these 37 sets were used in experiment 1 and v5.2 was tuned on football data; known blind spot: wrong_read recall ~11-29%
readout.frozen_rule: Primary comparisons: T vs G, T vs TB, T vs TO, TE vs TER. T vs TB: record adds value only if filled-line correct count is >=5 pp higher with paired (set-cluster bootstrap) CI lower bound >0; otherwise write that it doesn't. T vs G: >=10 pp on (a) with CI lower bound >0 and harm not more than G's. TE vs TER: record-guided escalation beats random escalation only if correct-line proportion difference >=10 pp with paired CI lower bound >0; also report TE's cost saving and correctness gap vs whole-report Haiku. Harm: if any arm's harm (c) is clearly higher than A's (CI lower >0), describe it as 'trading errors for fills' even if (a) rises. Indistinguishable if A's correct-line proportion >85% or <10%, or T sent feedback in <1/4 of cells.
readout.recorded_prediction: Recorded prediction (vacant-cloud, marked as a prediction): T beats A but is indistinguishable from TB.

secondary_offline_draft_selection.rule: Record-only evidence score = supported_lines - unsupported_lines (blank + non-blank flagged); ties broken by fewer blanks; evaluated offline on available shared drafts per set vs uniform random pick (expected value) and oracle best by answer key.
